description: K-NET and KiK-net strong-motion seismograph networks (NIED) is a data network run by National Research Institute for Earth Science and Disaster Resilience (NIED), Japan. The site distributes strong-motion records from the K-NET surface stations and the KiK-net borehole and surface stations, with site information, for earthquakes recorded across Japan. Coverage: Japan (nationwide network). It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as ascii, text; access is free of charge with registration. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("防災科学技術研究所 強震観測網(K-NET, KiK-net)") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support ground-motion records for fragility and seismic-loss studies of Japanese infrastructure. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
